translation: Not poisonous. Its chief actions are to treat stomach-impediment (胃痹), heart and abdominal pain, bound heat, pathogenic qi, headache, pathogenic heat between the skin, calm the five viscera, and supplement the center. One name is 苦心, one name 志取, one name 虎須, one name 白參, one name 識美, one name 文 [希].
